title: C#: 64 bit flags Enum only shows values up to 32 bits wide in Export property
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible on: v4.7.stable.mono.official [5b4e0cb0f] ### System information Godot v4.7.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9649) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.91 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description C# enums are by default 32 bits (int). It is however possible to make an enum 64 bits (long). When exporting a 64-bit flags enum to the editor, only the values which fit within a 32 bit space are visible. For example, the following, the enum inherits `long`, so it is 64 bit. ```csharp using System; using Godot; /// /// Base hugs the skin, such as a T-shirt. /// Outer covers the Base, such as a jacket. /// [Flags] public enum CharacterGearSlot : long { // inherits long None = 0, HeadHairBase = 1L << 1, HeadHairOuter = 1L << 2, HeadEyesBase = 1L << 3, HeadEyesOuter = 1L << 4, HeadMouthBase = 1L << 5, HeadMouthOuter = 1L << 6, TorsoUpperBase = 1L << 20, TorsoUpperOuter = 1L << 21, TorsoLowerBase = 1L << 22, TorsoLowerOuter = 1L << 23, ArmLeftUpperBase = 1L << 30, ArmLeftUpperOuter = 1L << 31, ArmLeftLowerBase = 1L << 32, ArmLeftLowerOuter = 1L << 33, ArmRightUpperBase = 1L << 40, ArmRightUpperOuter = 1L << 41, ArmRightLowerBase = 1L << 42, ArmRightLowerOuter = 1L << 43, LegsUpper = 1L << 50, LegsLower = 1L << 51, LegsFeet = 1L << 52, } [Tool, GlobalClass] public partial class CharacterGearResource : Resource { [Export] public CharacterGearSlot Slots { get; set; } } ``` Produces the following in the editor: Values greater than `1 << 31` are not represented. This issue is not present for non-flag enums (all values up to 64 its are selectable) ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create an enum in C# inheriting long 2. Decorate it with the [Flags] attribute. 3. Have an enum value greater than 1 << 31 4. Export it as a property in Godot 5. Observe values greater than 1<<31 cannot be selected ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Attached, but really this is all you need: ```csharp using Godot; using System; [Flags] public enum ExampleEnum : long { YouCanSeeMe = 1L << 31, YouCantSeeMe = 1L << 32 } public partial class Main : Node3D { [Export] ExampleEnum ExampleEnumProperty { get; set; } } ``` [my-long-is-too-short.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30972351/my-long-is-too-short.zip)
